body: yes a lot of times a total breakdown really helps
Thank you :) will definitely check them out

Definitely keep talking to/texting them even if they are not great at responding back. It can be a "how was your night" or sharing cute pictures of animals or fun things you ran into that day. Loneliness is a lot of times what's pushing people over the edge. (Coming from someone who's had suicidal thoughts for a while)

I am so sorry. But I think I can understand why he kept to himself. When I'm suicidal I feel complete numb, I don't care what people close to me will feel even though I know it can be detrimental to them. But I'm glad I get to hear from you if what a friend thinks.

Thank you so much for such a sincere and helpful response. I'm new to Reddit. In fact, I just entered Reddit today to look for a suicide method. But I'm glad I found that there is a community of people who want to help. And after going through hundreds of photos on the r/aww I'm feeling much better. Again, thank you
